sentences.zh: 周三在密苏里州圣查尔斯，总统登台时，背景是一堆圣诞树，台下是欢呼雀跃的人群。

sentences.en: Jim Tankersley covers taxes and the economy for the Times.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·坦克雷斯利为《时报》报道税收与经济。

sentences.zh: 他当时的心情非常欢快。

sentences.en: Just three months ago, we came to this state to launch our plan to bring back Main Street by cutting taxes for American families and small businesses.
sentences.zh: 就在三个月前，我们来到这个州发起我们的计划，通过为美国家庭和小型企业减税来重振商业街。

sentences.en: He wanted to talk about the tax bill, and he particularly wanted to brag.
sentences.zh: 他想谈谈税收法案，他特别想吹嘘一番。

sentences.en: I will tell you this in a non-braggadocious way.
sentences.zh: 我用一种不那么吹牛的方式告诉你们这一点。

sentences.en: There has never been a 10-month president that has accomplished what we have accomplished.
sentences.zh: 从来没有哪个总统在仅仅10个月内取得过我们这样的成就。

sentences.en: He wanted to talk about how great everything is going on in the economy right now, about how great growth is, about how low unemployment is.
sentences.zh: 他想谈谈现在经济运转得有多好，增长有多强劲，失业率有多低。

sentences.en: And then he wanted to say, and that's even before this tax cut, which, by the way, and he kept going into these
sentences.zh: 然后他想说，这还是在这项减税政策之前——顺便说一句，他接着开始发表这些

sentences.en: step-back rifts, this tax cut's going to be terrible for me, but it's going to be great for the country.
sentences.zh: 题外话：这项减税政策对我会很糟糕，但对国家会很好。

sentences.en: I think my accountants are going crazy right now.
sentences.zh: 我想我的会计师现在快疯了。

sentences.en: It's all right.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: Hey, look, I'm president.
sentences.zh: 嘿，听着，我是总统。

sentences.en: I don't care.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎。

sentences.en: I don't care anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎了。

sentences.en: I don't care.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎。

sentences.en: So this is the president basically out campaigning in the final days leading up to this expected
sentences.zh: 所以这是总统在距离共和党大型税改方案预计进行的

sentences.en: Senate vote on the Republicans' big tax reform plan.
sentences.zh: 参议院投票前的最后几天，基本上是在外地进行竞选活动。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was the president feeling like a candidate again, and he looked very comfortable and very happy, and he was a salesman.
sentences.zh: 是的，这让总统感觉自己又回到了候选人的状态，他看起来非常舒适、非常高兴，他就像个推销员。

sentences.en: The beating heart of our plan is a tax cut for working families.
sentences.zh: 我们计划的核心是为工薪家庭减税。

sentences.en: That's what it is.
sentences.zh: 事实就是这样。

sentences.en: He was talking about how great the bill was going to be for this and how great it was going to be
sentences.zh: 他一直在谈论这项法案对这个会多好，对那个会多好，

sentences.en: for that, and he was talking about being engaged with workers and how he feels like part of the
sentences.zh: 他谈到了与工人们的互动，以及他如何觉得自己是中产阶级的一部分，

sentences.en: middle class, and he launched into the longest riff I've heard in a long time on his famous we're going to have so much winning, we're sick of winning line.
sentences.zh: 接着他发表了我记忆中持续时间最长的一段关于他著名的“我们会一直赢，赢到你想吐”这句名言的即兴演讲。

sentences.en: We can't stand winning so much.
sentences.zh: 我们简直无法忍受赢了这么多。

sentences.en: Remember I used to say that, right?
sentences.zh: 还记得我以前常这么说吗？

sentences.en: I used to say it, and that's what's happening.
sentences.zh: 我以前经常说，而现在情况确实如此。

sentences.en: And it really was just classic Trump, and he just seemed almost jovial in his campaigning for the tax bill.
sentences.zh: 这真的是典型的特朗普风格，他在为税收法案拉票时显得几乎兴高采烈。

sentences.en: Under our plan, middle class families will not only see their tax bill go down, they will see their incomes go up by an average of around $4,000.
sentences.zh: 根据我们的计划，中产阶级家庭不仅会看到他们的税单减少，还会看到他们的收入平均增加约4000美元。

sentences.en: So this is the biggest legislative effort by the president and Republicans since they failed to repeal the Affordable Care Act back in the summer.
sentences.zh: 这是自今年夏天未能废除《平价医疗法案》以来，总统和共和党人发起的最大规模立法工作。

sentences.en: And I remember the conversation then was that the president was pretty uninvolved in that legislative effort.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时的讨论是，总统对那项立法工作几乎没有怎么参与。

sentences.en: This time seems different.
sentences.zh: 这次看起来不同了。

sentences.en: It does seem different.
sentences.zh: 确实看起来不同。

sentences.en: It's also sort of, let's grade him on a curve.
sentences.zh: 这也算是，让我们对他的表现放宽标准吧。

sentences.en: For this president, it's way more involved than he was in previous legislative effort.
sentences.zh: 对于这位总统来说，这比他以往参与立法工作的程度要深入得多。

sentences.en: He has been making phone calls to senators.
sentences.zh: 他一直在给参议员打电话。

sentences.en: He has been meeting with Republicans on Capitol Hill this week to try to round up support.
sentences.zh: 本周他一直在国会山会见共和党人，试图争取支持。

sentences.en: And he has, to some degree, been out in the country trying to make the case for the tax bill.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他也一直在全国各地奔走，为税收法案进行辩护。

sentences.en: He's gone to a few states, held a few rallies.
sentences.zh: 他去了几个州，举行了几场集会。

sentences.en: It's been much more than he did on health care.
sentences.zh: 这比他在医疗保健议题上做的要多得多。

sentences.en: It is also far less, for example, than President Obama did to try to sell the Affordable Care Act when Congress was considering that.
sentences.zh: 但这也远比奥巴马总统在国会审议《平价医疗法案》时为推销该法案所做的努力要少，例如。

sentences.en: Well, why do we think it's different than with health care?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么我们认为这次与医改时不同呢？

sentences.en: Why do we think President Trump is getting more involved?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们认为特朗普总统参与得更多了？

sentences.en: I think there's two reasons the president's getting more involved.
sentences.zh: 我认为总统更多参与其中有两个原因。

sentences.en: One is just he loves this issue.
sentences.zh: 首先是他纯粹热爱这个议题。

sentences.en: He feels much more comfortable with taxes.
sentences.zh: 他对税收感到更加自如。

sentences.en: He was talking again today, I'm a businessman.
sentences.zh: 他今天又在说，我是个商人。

sentences.en: I don't really understand politics, but I'm a businessman.
sentences.zh: 我其实不懂政治，但我是个商人。

sentences.en: The second reason, though, is that this is a much more critical time for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 不过第二个原因是，对共和党人来说，这是一个更加关键的时刻。

sentences.en: Their failure on health care has them absolutely desperate for a victory.
sentences.zh: 他们在医改上的失败让他们绝对渴望一场胜利。

sentences.en: And so the president needs that, too.
sentences.zh: 因此总统也需要这个。

sentences.en: He wants a crowning legislative accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 他想要一个能为自己加冕的立法成就。

sentences.en: This would be a win.
sentences.zh: 这将是一场胜利。

sentences.en: He can see how close they are to a win.
sentences.zh: 他能看到他们距离胜利有多近。

sentences.en: And I think that's why we're seeing him now in particular getting more involved.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是为什么我们现在看到他格外积极地参与进来。

sentences.en: So what exactly has the president been doing to shape this legislation and to try to get this crucial win?
sentences.zh: 那么总统究竟做了什么来塑造这项立法并试图赢得这至关重要的胜利？

sentences.en: When does he first get involved?
sentences.zh: 他是什么时候第一次介入的？

sentences.en: And what is he saying?
sentences.zh: 他又在说些什么？

sentences.en: Well, he's been involved from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他从一开始就参与其中了。

sentences.en: The White House worked with congressional leaders to craft a framework, some principles for the tax bill.
sentences.zh: 白宫与国会领导人合作，制定了一个税收法案的框架和一些原则。

sentences.en: So this is our once in a generation opportunity to deliver real tax reform for everyday hardworking
sentences.zh: 所以这是我们千载难逢的机会，为日常努力工作的美国人

sentences.en: Americans.
sentences.zh: 带来真正的税制改革。

sentences.en: But really, it was around August when he really started getting involved.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，大约在8月份，他才真正开始深入参与。

sentences.en: And the first thing he did was just really hit the accelerator.
sentences.zh: 他做的第一件事就是真正踩下油门。

sentences.en: The president making his case by hitting the road, specifically Route 66, known as America's Main Street, promising to help small businesses and the middle class.
sentences.zh: 总统通过实地走访来阐述他的观点，特别是沿着被誉为美国商业街的66号公路，承诺帮助小企业和中产阶级。

sentences.en: Telling Congress to get going.
sentences.zh: 告诉国会行动起来。

sentences.en: He wanted a tax bill.
sentences.zh: 他想要一个税收法案。

sentences.en: He wanted a tax bill.
sentences.zh: 他想要一个税收法案。

sentences.en: He wanted a tax bill.
sentences.zh: 他想要一个税收法案。

sentences.en: And I am fully committed to working with Congress to get this job done.
sentences.zh: 我完全致力于与国会合作以完成这项工作。

sentences.en: And I don't want to be disappointed by Congress.
sentences.zh: 我不想被国会失望。

sentences.en: Do you understand me?
sentences.zh: 你们听懂了吗？

sentences.en: Do you understand?
sentences.zh: 你们明白吗？

sentences.en: What Republicans will tell you is that the president's pressure has really had an effect.
sentences.zh: 共和党人会告诉你的是，总统的施压确实产生了效果。

sentences.en: He has absolutely sped up this process to the point where they introduced a bill in the House on
sentences.zh: 他绝对加快了这一进程，以至于他们在11月1日

sentences.en: November 1St. And they might pass it out of the Senate before December 1St.
sentences.zh: 就在众议院提出了法案。他们甚至可能在12月1日之前在参议院通过它。

sentences.en: Which is faSt.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是相当快了。

sentences.en: That would be fast for naming a post office.
sentences.zh: 给邮局命名都未必有这么快。

sentences.en: It's particularly fast for a 500-plus page of tax code rewrite.
sentences.zh: 对于一个长达500多页的税法重写案来说，这尤其之快。

sentences.en: So as you said, the president has been championing this as a bill primarily for the middle class.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，总统一直将此作为一项主要针对中产阶级的法案来大力宣传。

sentences.en: Why has he framed it that way?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要这样定调？

sentences.en: He's always framed it that way.
sentences.zh: 他一直都是这么定调的。

sentences.en: He's framed it that way in the campaign.
sentences.zh: 他在竞选时就是这么说的。

sentences.en: I am proposing an across-the-board income tax reduction, especially for middle-income Americans.
sentences.zh: 我提议全面减征所得税，特别是为中等收入的美国人减税。

sentences.en: This will lead to millions of new and really good-paying jobs.
sentences.zh: 这将带来数百万个新的、真正高薪的工作岗位。

sentences.en: The rich will pay their fair share.
sentences.zh: 富人将支付他们应付的份额。

sentences.en: He is a populist politician.
sentences.zh: 他是一个民粹主义政治家。

sentences.en: He has always been pitching to workers.
sentences.zh: 他一直都在迎合工人群体。

sentences.en: And that has always been sort of the message that he understood really resonated in the country.
sentences.zh: 这始终是他认为在全国上下最能引起共鸣的信息。

sentences.en: And that is why Republicans have followed him in Congress.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么国会的共和党人一直跟随他。

sentences.en: They have just been relentlessly on a message saying that this would be a middle-class tax cut.
sentences.zh: 他们坚定不移地传递着一个信息，即这将是一场针对中产阶级的减税。

sentences.en: This plan is for the middle-class families in this country who deserve a break.
sentences.zh: 这个计划是为了这个国家配得上喘息之机的中产阶级家庭。

sentences.en: It is for the families who are out there living paycheck to paycheck who just keep getting squeezed.
sentences.zh: 它是为了那些靠薪水过活、不断受到挤压的家庭。

sentences.en: Has his influence over the past couple of months helped shape this bill into a bill for the middle class?
sentences.zh: 过去几个月他对法案的影响力，是否帮助将其塑造为一项针对中产阶级的法案？

sentences.en: Because, of course, there's been a lot of criticism that it's anything but a middle-class tax package.
sentences.zh: 因为当然有很多批评认为这绝不是什么中产阶级减税打包方案。

sentences.en: This bill would do more by every analysis we've seen for the wealthy and high earners than it would for the middle class.
sentences.zh: 根据我们看到的每一项分析，这项法案对富人和高收入者带来的好处，都比对中产阶级的好处要多得多。

sentences.en: It is not a bill that is going to massively cut taxes or send more money from
sentences.zh: 与它退还给企业和高收入者的资金相比，它并不是一项会大幅削减税收或将更多资金

sentences.en: the federal government back to middle-class taxpayers compared to how much it sends back to corporations and high earners.
sentences.zh: 从联邦政府送回中产阶级纳税人手里的法案。

sentences.en: Now, the president, in a couple of ways, kept the bill that way and, in fact, tried unsuccessfully to push it even more in favor of high earners.
sentences.zh: 然而，总统在几个方面保持了法案的这种倾向，事实上，他甚至曾试图进一步推动它向有利于高收入者的方向倾斜，尽管没有成功。

sentences.en: The big way he has kept the bill to favor corporations is by insisting on a cut in the corporate tax rate to no more than 20 percent.
sentences.zh: 他使法案倾向于企业的主要方式，是坚持将企业税率削减至不超过20%。

sentences.en: It's 35 percent at the top now.
sentences.zh: 目前最高税率是35%。

sentences.en: He wants it all the way down to 20 percent.
sentences.zh: 他希望一路降至20%。

sentences.en: That's a red line for the president.
sentences.zh: 这是总统划定的红线。

sentences.en: From 35 percent to 20 percent in the corporate tax rate is a big cut.
sentences.zh: 将企业税率从35%降至20%是一个巨大的降幅。

sentences.en: It's a really big cut.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一个巨大的降幅。

sentences.en: It's an aggressive cut.
sentences.zh: 这是一个激进的减税幅度。

sentences.en: But it's not the only thing in the bill that would help high earners.
sentences.zh: 但它并不是法案中唯一有助于高收入者的内容。

sentences.en: There's also a big cut for the types of businesses that Mr. Trump owns.
sentences.zh: 参议院的法案中也对特朗普先生所拥有的那种类型的企业进行了大幅减税。

sentences.en: And there is a reduction in the Senate bill in the top individual income tax rate.
sentences.zh: 参议院的法案还降低了个人所得税的最高税率。

sentences.en: And the president actually pushed the Senate to make that cut bigger, and he failed.
sentences.zh: 而且总统实际上曾敦促参议院将这一减税幅度做得更大，但他失败了。

sentences.en: So at the same time that the president has championed this bill as a middle-class tax bill over and over again, he has pushed the bill in directions that actually are hugely
sentences.zh: 因此，一方面总统一次又一次地将该法案宣传为中产阶级税收法案，另一方面他却将法案推向了实际上对美国最富有的人（包括他自己）

sentences.en: beneficial to the richest people in America, including him.
sentences.zh: 极为有利的方向。

sentences.en: The president keeps saying that this bill is a big middle-class tax cut and that it's going to really hurt rich people.
sentences.zh: 总统一直说这项法案是一场重大的中产阶级减税，而且会真正伤害到富人。

sentences.en: This is going to cost me a fortune, this thing.
sentences.zh: 这东西会花掉我一大笔钱。

sentences.en: Believe me.
sentences.zh: 相信我。

sentences.en: Believe me.
sentences.zh: 相信我。

sentences.en: This is not good for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我也没好处。

sentences.en: Me, it's not.
sentences.zh: 对我来说确实没有。

sentences.en: So I have some very wealthy friends not so happy with me, but that's OK.
sentences.zh: 所以我有些非常富有的朋友对我不太高兴，但没关系。

sentences.en: You know, I keep hearing Schumer, deuces for the wealthy.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我总听到舒默说这是给富人的大礼。

sentences.en: Well, if it is, my friends don't know about it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果是这样的话，我的朋友们可一点也不知道。

sentences.en: There is no evidence that it's going to really hurt rich people.
sentences.zh: 没有证据表明这会真正伤害富人。

sentences.en: And just because he says it doesn't make it true, but he keeps saying it.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为他这么说并不意味着它就是真的，但他一直在说。

sentences.en: So he is selling the bill the way he's always sold the bill.
